scientific_role: cross-theory residual discovery service; candidate-edge generator only

packet_schema.predicted: scalar or vector from theory-local frozen model
packet_schema.residual: observed - predicted, or preregistered signed discrepancy
packet_schema.known_edges: list of theory-known connections removed before LX scan

MDO.note: No time/causal theorem is licensed by the MDO paper. Dynamic LX use requires a separately preregistered graph-sequence adapter.

SRRD.note: Use seed/trajectory residuals; do not encode 'SRRD decomposition identified' because Phase 2 rejected that stronger claim.

PH.note: Carry evidence_level and final non-identifiability flag. v0.3 detector-validation outputs must not be promoted to latent-node identity.

HISTORY_CAUSALITY.note: Residual must be after state representation / reset control.

FPCRH_FCA.note: FPCRH v2.1 is hypothesis/design level; no FCA experimental residual stream located.

HCVL.note: Phase 1C is FALSIFIED_OR_INCONCLUSIVE for representation-independent identification; preserve that evidence flag.

detector.null_control: family-wise max over all 15 pairs and all lags
detector.threshold_rule: 95th percentile (higher order statistic) from null calibration seeds
detector.global_mode_rule: report number of pairwise scores exceeding frozen threshold; do not call a pair causal when broad/global activation is present

gates.G0: interface schema frozen and provenance present
gates.G4: global driver flagged as broad/global rather than localized pair in >=0.80
gates.G6: representation stability on a fresh transform family
